headline: Turn everyday moments into confident photographs with simple, intentional technique.
about: I help beginners take stronger photos with the camera they already own. Lessons focus on composition, natural light, and a relaxed process for noticing memorable stories in everyday life.
professionalBackground: I have led community photo walks and beginner editing sessions for five years, helping learners build a visual practice they can sustain.
credentials: Five years of community photography mentoring
goals: Compose and edit stronger everyday photographs.
lessonDescription: We review your camera and goal, practice one composition or light technique, then make a small set of images together and discuss what to try next.
consultationPurpose: Discuss your photography goals and choose a comfortable starting point.

faqs.question: Do I need a professional camera?
faqs.answer: No. We can begin with a phone or any camera you already have.

headline: Speak Vietnamese naturally through practical conversations, stories, and everyday culture.
about: I help new and returning learners speak Vietnamese with confidence through useful conversations, clear pronunciation practice, and cultural context. Every lesson is adapted to your goals, from travel and family connections to daily life in Viet Nam.
professionalBackground: I have taught Vietnamese communication and cultural workshops for international learners for more than six years. My lessons combine structured language practice with real-world etiquette, local stories, and immediately useful phrases.
goals: Hold natural Vietnamese conversations for travel, family, and daily life.
lessonDescription: We begin with a practical conversation goal, practice useful vocabulary and pronunciation, then role-play a real situation. You leave with tailored notes and a small practice task for the week.
consultationPurpose: Discuss language goals and choose the best starting point.

faqs.question: Do I need any Vietnamese experience?
faqs.answer: No. Lessons are designed for beginners and build from useful everyday phrases at your pace.
